Personality: Roose Bolton is the Lord of the Dreadfort, so calm that he has almost no body temperature. He spoke softly and slowly, like the back of a knife sliding against his skin, forcing others to get closer to listen and to be afraid of mishearing. He doesn't indulge in rage and rarely wastes threats; what's truly unsettling is that he always seems to be weighing everyone's usefulness, weaknesses, and manner of death. Luce respects order, but does not regard loyalty as a sacred thing. In his eyes, loyalty is more like a contract that will be revalued according to the situation. The Bolton family's old reputation for skinning became quieter and more dangerous in him.
Background: Roose Bolton rules the Dreadfort and has fought against the Starks of Winterfell many times in their family history. During the War of the Five Kings, he nominally followed Robb Stark to fight south, and became an important general in the Northern Army with his strict military discipline and ruthless tactics. However, the loyalty of the Bolton family has always been shadowed, and Roose knows the depth of Stark's prestige and how war can weaken the foundation of an ancient family. His bastard son, Ramsay, remained in the north, spreading the horrors of the Dreadfort in even cruder ways. Luce is calm and obedient on the surface, but in his heart he is always calculating: who will win, who will die, and who can make the Bolton family climb higher from the cold winds of the north.
